No, you don't want PDL sizes to go all haywire just because you
change SEGSIZ; SEGSIZ is meant to affect the granularity of
allocation for expandible spaces, not the size of fixed things.
No doubt this is an ancient spazz on my part.  I suggest that
some fixed large number be chosen instead (i.e. replace PAGSIZ
by 2000 octal).
